description: Smart Meter AI-Ready Dataset for Household Consumption Anomaly Detection is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors SeyedMohammad Vahedi (Vilnius Gediminas Technical University (VILNIUS TECH)). This dataset contains AI-ready smart meter electricity consumption data prepared for household-level anomaly detection. It was generated during Phase 2 of the Smart Meter Energy Demand Forecasting & Consumption Anomaly Detection Platform project. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
